item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 07/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be brighter over the region. Winds will be relatively weak over the coastal areas in the middle and latter parts of this week. Visibility will be rather low in some areas, and it will be rather warm during the day. Meanwhile, showers associated with upper-air disturbances will affect inland Guangdong. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China over the weekend. With the trough of low pressure departing from the coastal areas, showers will ease off early next week.
